title: Flagged full-stack feature
description: Deliver one new feature dark, behind a FlagPole flag, as separately deployable PRs: flag + data model, then API, then UI, then an in-slot proof. Backend lands before the frontend that depends on it. Pass the flag to every gate as HAR_FLAG=organizations:<name>.

mcp.name: linear
mcp.why: the feature ticket is the traveler: contract from S1, PR links, gate evidence per station

stations.title: Contract
stations.description: No code, no slot. Write on the ticket: the flag name (organizations:<name>, temporary, FlagPole, api_expose if the UI needs it), the models and which silo owns them, each endpoint's route/method/scopes/request+response shape (camelCase bodies, string ids, `detail` errors), and the UI entry point. A human approves the contract before S2.

stations.title: Flag + data model (backend PR 1)
stations.description: One slot, backend only: register the flag in temporary.py (default off), add the model(s) and migration with the generate-migration skill, apply it to the slot DB (sentry upgrade --noinput, then har env agent <id> restart). Skip the model part if the contract has none; the flag still lands here.

stations.title: API behind the flag (backend PR 2)
stations.description: One slot, backend only, after PR 1 merged: endpoints/serializers per the contract, every new path gated with features.has(HAR_FLAG, ...), tests with self.feature(...) on and a flag-off case. Review with sentry-security (org scoping, IDOR) and sentry-backend-bugs before handoff. Never add an RPC method and its first caller in the same PR.

stations.title: UI behind the flag (frontend PR)
stations.description: One slot, static/ only, after the backend PRs are DEPLOYED (the frontend calls the new API): UI gated with organization.features.includes('<short name>'), data via apiOptions/useQuery, specs that render with the flag on. Review with sentry-javascript-bugs.

stations.title: Prove in a slot
stations.description: One slot on a branch containing all PRs: enable the flag for org `sentry` in the slot, drive the feature as a user with the verify-sentry skill, attach screenshots and API evidence to the ticket. Also check the flag-off path shows nothing. No new code unless the proof finds a defect — then fix it in the PR that owns it and re-run that station's gate.

extraStages.description: HAR_FLAG registered in temporary.py as FlagPole, default off
src/ reads HAR_FLAG and tests/ enable it
api_expose=True, static/app checks the short name, a spec enables it

handoff.waitFor: human review and merge of each PR; backend PRs deployed before S4 starts; human decides rollout in sentry-options-automator

traveler.note: S1 contract, then one comment per station with PR link and gate result. Squash merges drop commit footers, so the ticket is the record.

prototypeNotes: HAR_FLAG is per-run input: HAR_FLAG=organizations:my-feature har line gate S3 --line flagged-feature --agent 3.
S2 and S3 may be one PR when there is no model; keep them separate stations so the gate still asks both questions.
pr-split runs at every station from S2: each slot's diff is one deployable PR, never static/ mixed with src/.
S5 has no stage of its own yet: the proof is verify-sentry evidence on the ticket. When a proof catches a class of defect, add a stage and tag it fromStation S5.
Rollout (flagpole.yaml in sentry-options-automator) is out of scope — the line ends at a dark, proven feature.
